# featbit_project (Data Source)

Reads one FeatBit Project by exact UUID or organization-scoped case-sensitive exact key.

Configure exactly one selector: `id` for a UUID or `key` for an
organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact key. Key lookup scans the complete
Project collection and rejects zero or duplicate exact matches; it never
selects a fuzzy or first result. Returned Environments are canonical,
non-owning observations; secret values and UI settings are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_key" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact FeatBit Project key."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_project" "exact" {
  key = var.project_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Exact Project UUID. Configure exactly one of `id` or `key`.
- `key` (String) Organization-scoped case-sensitive exact Project key. Configure exactly one of `id` or `key`.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Canonical, non-owning observations of the Project environments. Secret values and settings are not exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `name` (String) Project display name.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Environment description.
- `id` (String) Environment UUID.
- `key` (String) Environment key.
- `name` (String) Environment display name.
